The return-to-page part feels exactly right. I clicked the **JavaScript | MDN** card and it opened the actual MDN page, and my Link Home tab was still sitting there when I came back. Making the whole card clickable is nice — I don't have to aim for a tiny link. Good.

One thing I noticed while doing what you asked, though. You had me save the same MDN address a second time. I couldn't really tell what happened to my collection — it just showed the one card again. What I'd want in that situation is: if I try to save a link I've already got, it shouldn't quietly make a second copy of it. I'd rather it recognize "you already saved this one" and just take me to the existing one so I can update it if I want, instead of ending up with duplicates cluttering things up. Can you show me what happens when I save an address that's already in my collection?
